nodes.label: Lean opponent sessions
nodes.rationale: Reduces token context from ~20k to ~2k (90% cut), lowering cost from $0.0215 to $0.0039 per decision. Prioritizes token compression over latency per explicit human requirement.

nodes.label: --disallowedTools flag
nodes.rationale: Drops tool schemas from context, eliminating dead weight since opponent never calls tools

nodes.label: Static minimal system prompt
nodes.rationale: Must remain static to maintain identical prompt cache prefix across calls. Cache warms after first call in 5-minute window.

nodes.label: Tool schemas (Bash, Read, Edit, ...)
nodes.rationale: ~11k of ~20k context tokens in full session; eliminated as dead weight

nodes.label: Token compression
nodes.rationale: Explicitly prioritized over latency; any sub-5-second response is acceptable

nodes.label: Tool restrictions mid-decision
nodes.rationale: Prevents accidental file reads/writes during poker hand

nodes.label: Hidden Information Doctrine
nodes.rationale: In poker, never truthfully reveal hole cards; mislead if mentioning cards at all

nodes.label: Poker Strategy Principles
nodes.rationale: Think about pot odds, position, ranges, stack depth, betting history; fold trash, punish weakness, protect stack

nodes.label: Amount Field
nodes.rationale: Total chips being bet/raised TO (not increment); required for bet/raise; omitted for fold/check/call

nodes.label: Say Field
nodes.rationale: Optional one-line table talk; must not reveal actual hole cards
